_readme: Items not machine-extracted: guidance, debt, deals / PPAs, capacity auctions and contracts, share data, share price. Every item cites its EDGAR source. USD m unless stated.

fy26.history: Sep-2024 Investor Day outlook 2026E: not carried; 27-Feb-2025 n/a; FY26 first guided 15-Jan-2026 (Cornerstone call); 26-Feb-2026 Adj. EBITDA $1,750-2,050m (ex Cornerstone); 3-Nov-2026 $2,050-2,200m and Adj. FCF $1,225-1,325m (narrowed, midpoint reaffirmed)

fy27.src: 8-K 3-Nov-2026 Ex. 99.1: 2027 guidance introduced (figures rounded to the nearest $5m)

guidance.leverage_target: Net leverage target 3.5x net debt / Adjusted EBITDA (Q3-26 release)
guidance.hedges: 30-Sep-2026, incl. the Nuclear PTC: ~80% of expected Oct-Dec 2026 generation hedged, ~70% of 2027, ~35% of 2028 (Q3-26 release)

expected_capacity_revenues.src: Q3-26 10-Q Note 3 (future fixed-fee performance obligations at 30-Sep-2026; includes volumes awarded in PJM BRAs through May 2029; thereafter = contracts through 2035)

monetization.note: TEM transferred rights to $1.5bn of PJM capacity cash flows (c. 6.5 GW 2027/28 and 6.0 GW 2028/29). Advanced proceeds are a liability; revenue is still recognised; the $157m discount is an implied finance charge amortised to interest expense through May-2029; PJM pays the third party from Jun-2027.

capacity.guernsey_sale: 8-K 12-Nov-2026 (Item 8.01): Guernsey 750 MW UCAP sold for PJM delivery years 2029/30-2035/36 (~$100m a year) plus 588 MW for 2029/30; Waterford capacity sale to the same investment-grade counterparty

contracts.aws_ppa: Amended AWS PPA (Jun-2025): up to 1,920 MW of Susquehanna output through 2042, front-of-the-meter transition spring 2026-spring 2027 (FY2025 10-K Item 1)

fuel_contract_amort.src: FY2025 10-K Note 17: amortization of acquired fuel supply contract liabilities (Freedom to Jul-2028, Guernsey to Feb-2033), a reduction of fuel and energy purchases

capacity_contract_amort.src: Q3-26 10-Q Note 17: acquired capacity contract liability (Cornerstone), an increase to capacity revenues from 2028

Q4-25.note: FY2025 10-K Note 17 (provisional): cash 47, receivables 29, other assets 10, PP&E 4,509; payables 28, derivatives 49, other liabilities 11, acquired fuel supply contract liabilities 667; purchase price 3,840 (3,793 net of cash acquired). No goodwill.

Q2-26.note: Q3-26 10-Q Note 17 (provisional, as revised in Q3-26): cash 47, receivables 38, inventory 31, other current 12, PP&E 4,214; payables 43, current derivative liabilities 93, ARO 5, acquired contract liabilities 151, deferred taxes 457, noncurrent derivatives 49; consideration 3,544 = cash 2,617 + 2,399,998 shares at $386.21 (927); 3,497 net of cash acquired. No goodwill.

deals.freedom_guernsey: Acquired 25-Nov-2025 from Caithness: Freedom (PA) and Guernsey (OH) CCGTs, ~2.8 GW, $3.8bn cash; financed with TLB-3 $1.2bn and 2034 / 2036 unsecured notes $2.69bn (8-Ks 27-Oct-2025, 25-Nov-2025). Since acquisition to 31-Dec-2025: revenues $153m, net income $62m.
deals.cornerstone: Acquired 15-Jun-2026: ~2.6 GW (Waterford and Darby, OH; Lawrenceburg, IN), $3.5bn = $2,617m cash + 2.4m shares; financed with $1.5bn 6.125% 2031 and $2.5bn 6.375% 2033 unsecured notes (Apr-2026), which also redeemed the $1.2bn 8.625% secured notes. 15-Jun to 30-Sep-2026: revenues $835m, net income $273m (incl. unrealized derivative results).
deals.keystone: Sep-2026: 12.34% Keystone interest sold for $73m (gain $66m). Sep-2025: Camden and Dartmouth sold for $25m (gain $22m).
deals.2024: Cumulus data campus sold to AWS (Mar-2024, $650m) and the ERCOT fleet sold (May-2024): aggregate gain ~$888m.

debt.one_offs_2026: Q2-26: $60m make-whole and write-off on the redemption of the secured notes and $18m on the TLB-1 extension, in interest expense (Q3-26 10-Q Note 10).

equity.asr: ASR of $1.5bn entered 29-Sep-2026; 3,811,460 shares received and retired on 1-Oct-2026 (80% of $1.5bn at $314.84); final settlement by Q1-2027 (Q3-26 10-Q Note 15 and Part II Item 2)
equity.sbc_2025: Q4-25: $501m charge on the change in accounting for existing stock-based awards (liability-classified); $500m cash-settled in 2026 (cash-flow statement)

price.form: Form 4 (filed 19-Nov-2026), open-market sale by a director/officer (E. T. Casulli), 3,602 shares at $354.52
price.other: Same day Form 4 (B. Berryman) sales at $345.44-348.73; 11-Nov-2026 sale at $382.74; ASR reference price 1-Oct-2026 $314.84; Aug-2026 average repurchase price $339.47 (Q3-26 10-Q Part II Item 2).

shares_out.src: Balance-sheet footnotes of the S-1 (31-Dec-2023; 31-Mar-2024 from the capitalization table: 59,028,843 issued, 58,535,843 outstanding), 10-Qs and 10-Ks (shares issued and outstanding; 30-Jun-2024: 53,259,981 issued, 53,254,954 outstanding)
